name: Crank drive X
description: Moves a point in a circle about a fixed centre by acting on its X position directly: X changes at −Angular velocity × (target Y − source Y), the X part of a point turning about the source at a constant rate, so no angle state is needed. Connect it from a Free body that stays put (the pivot) to a second Free body (the crank pin), and apply Crank drive Y between the same two. The radius of the circle is the starting distance between the two bodies; the motion preserves it, so it is not a parameter. Angular velocity (rad/s, default 1, live) is how fast the pin turns about the pivot, counter-clockwise when X points right and Y up; it can be changed during a run. Crank drive X and Crank drive Y each carry their own Angular velocity and must hold the same value, so link them to one shared parameter in the Parameters table to keep them in step.
